sourcePdf.provenance: PDF metadata did not establish title, author, version, or original source. Uploaded filename is the only identifying label. Redistribution permission was not established; only concepts were used.
sourcePdf.countMethod: Extract with pdftotext -layout. Counting case-insensitive QUESTION plus integer only at the start of an extracted line (regex ^\s*QUESTION\s+\d+) yields 1,213; counting that pattern anywhere in the extracted text yields 1,259.
sourcePdf.countDiscrepancy: For this verified PDF SHA-256, line-start-only counting yields 1,213 headings while counting QUESTION plus an integer anywhere in the extracted text yields 1,259. Thus 46 headings were not at line starts in the extraction. The anywhere count comprises six complete 200-question sections and one 59-question section; numbering restarts within each section.

additionalCandidateReviews.result: Repeated CSV-to-Parquet concept. Glue key is supported; Exam B Q9 explanation is unrelated encryption guidance. One original item added.

Key D’s lifecycle plan is incomplete under current default S3 lifecycle behavior for 10 KB objects; explicit smaller-size allowance is required to transition them. New item tests this specific behavior and avoids unverified pricing comparisons.

Rejected as technically unsound. Current RDS SQL Server documentation supports Multi-AZ with Always On AGs for supported versions/editions. FSx shared storage is pertinent to Failover Cluster Instance designs, not a blanket requirement for AGs. Sources: https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AmazonRDS/latest/UserGuide/USER_SQLServerMultiAZ.html and https://docs.aws.amazon.com/fsx/latest/WindowsGuide/sql-server.html.
Not added because existing q-saa-core-32 already assesses Secrets Manager automatic database-password rotation. Candidate key is consistent with current AWS guidance.
